section.content: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery production, and provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises: the battery barrel comprises a steel shell and an inner core, one end of the battery barrel is sealed, the other end of the battery barrel is provided with an opening, the steel shell positioned outside the opening is turned over towards the axis direction of the battery barrel to form an accommodating cavity, and a bulge part is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity; the cap assembly is fixed in the accommodating cavity and seals the opening, the cap assembly comprises a steel cap, an explosion-proof valve, a metal connecting piece and a first sealing ring, the steel cap, the explosion-proof valve and the metal connecting piece are sleeved with the first sealing ring, and the bottom surface of the first sealing ring is attached to the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity and extrudes the bottom surface of the first sealing ring through the protruding portion. The utility model improves the sealing performance between the battery cylinder and the cap assembly, avoids the liquid in the battery cylinder from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high place, and improves the quality of the lithium ion battery.

本实用新型涉及电池生产技术领域，提供了一种锂离子电池，包括：电池筒体，电池筒体包括钢壳和内芯，电池筒体一端密封，另一端设置有开口，位于开口外侧的钢壳向电池筒体的轴线方向翻折形成一容置腔，容置腔的底面上设置有凸起部；盖帽组件，盖帽组件固定于容置腔内并将开口密封，盖帽组件包括钢帽、防爆阀、金属连接片和第一密封圈，第一密封圈将钢帽、防爆阀和金属连接片均套设在其内部，其中，第一密封圈的底面与容置腔的底面贴合且凸起部挤压第一密封圈的底面。本实用新型提高了电池筒体与盖帽组件之间的密封性，避免了锂离子电池在从高处跌落后，电池筒体内部的液体向外部泄漏，提高了锂离子电池的质量。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of battery production, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Batteries, as a device for converting chemical energy into electrical energy, are used in a large area in many fields, and along with the rapid development of society, the demand of batteries is increasing. At present, batteries on the market are mainly classified into dry batteries, lead storage batteries, lithium ion batteries and the like. The lithium ion battery is a novel high-energy battery taking lithium as a negative electrode, and has the advantages of high single battery voltage, large specific energy, long storage life and good high-low temperature performance.

Along with the improvement of degree of automation, lithium ion battery's production efficiency has obtained very big promotion, however, current lithium ion battery is in the production process, and the leakproofness between battery barrel and the block subassembly is relatively poor, and after lithium ion battery fell from the eminence, the steel casing of battery barrel can take place to warp and make the gap appear between battery and the sealing washer, and the inside liquid of battery can leak to lithium ion battery outside along the gap, leads to lithium ion battery to damage or even scrap.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a lithium ion battery, which improves the sealing property between a battery barrel and a cap assembly and improves the quality of the lithium ion battery.

The embodiment of the application provides a lithium ion battery, including:

the battery barrel comprises a steel shell and an inner core, one end of the battery barrel is sealed, the other end of the battery barrel is provided with an opening, the steel shell positioned outside the opening is turned over towards the axis direction of the battery barrel to form an accommodating cavity, and a protruding part is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity;

the cap assembly is fixed in the accommodating cavity and seals the opening, the cap assembly comprises a steel cap, an explosion-proof valve, a metal connecting sheet and a first sealing ring, the steel cap, the explosion-proof valve and the metal connecting sheet are sequentially stacked, and the steel cap, the explosion-proof valve and the metal connecting sheet are all sleeved in the first sealing ring;

the top surface of the first sealing ring is attached to the top surface of the containing cavity, the bottom surface of the first sealing ring is attached to the bottom surface of the containing cavity, and the protruding portion extrudes the bottom surface of the first sealing ring.

In some embodiments, the protrusions are annularly distributed, and the protrusions surround the opening.

In some embodiments, the protrusion includes a plurality of sub-protrusions spaced apart and arranged in a ring shape, and the protrusion surrounds the opening.

In some of these embodiments, the side edges of the upper end surface of the protruding portion are rounded.

In some of these embodiments, the height of the projections is 0.08mm to 0.15 mm.

In some of these embodiments, the height of the boss is 0.10 mm.

In some of these embodiments, the cap assembly further comprises a second seal ring disposed between the explosion-proof valve and the metal connecting piece.

In some embodiments, the first sealing ring is made of PP or rubber.

In some of these embodiments, the metal tabs are aluminum tabs.

In some of these embodiments, the explosion-proof valve and the metal connecting piece are connected together by welding.

The lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the utility model has the beneficial effects that: because the bulge is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity, when the cap assembly is fixed in the accommodating cavity and seals the opening of the battery barrel, the bulge can extrude the bottom surface of the first sealing ring, so that the first sealing ring is deformed to a certain degree and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity, the sealing property between the battery barrel and the cap assembly is improved, the phenomenon that the liquid inside the battery barrel leaks to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high place is avoided, and the quality of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings needed to be used in the embodiments or the prior art descriptions will be briefly described below, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious for those skilled in the art to obtain other drawings based on these drawings without inventive exercise.

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is an enlarged partial view of portion A of FIG. 1;

FIG. 3 is a schematic diagram of the structure of a battery can in one embodiment of the utility model;

FIG. 4 is a cross-sectional view taken along line M-M of FIG. 3 in one embodiment of the present invention;

FIG. 5 is a cross-sectional view taken along the line M-M of FIG. 3 in accordance with another embodiment of the present invention;

FIG. 6 is a schematic view of the mating structure of the battery can and the lower clamping mold according to one embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 7 is a partially enlarged view of a portion B in fig. 6.

The designations in the figures mean:

100. a lithium ion battery; 10. a battery can; 11. a steel shell; 12. an inner core; 13. an opening; 14. an accommodating cavity; 15. a boss portion; 20. a cap assembly; 21. a steel cap; 22. an explosion-proof valve; 23. a metal connecting sheet; 24. a first seal ring; 25. a second seal ring; 200. clamping the die; 210. a jacking portion.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more apparent, the present invention will be described in further detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings, which are examples. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the utility model and are not intended to limit the utility model.

It will be understood that when an element is referred to as being "secured to" or "disposed on" another element, it can be directly on the other element or be indirectly on the other element. When an element is referred to as being "connected to" another element, it can be directly connected to the other element or be indirectly connected to the other element.

Furthermore, the terms "first", "second" and "first" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance or implicitly indicating the number of technical features indicated. Thus, a feature defined as "first" or "second" may explicitly or implicitly include one or more of that feature. In the description of the present invention, "a plurality" means two or more unless specifically defined otherwise.

In order to explain the technical solution of the present invention, the following description is made with reference to the specific drawings and examples.

Referring to fig. 1, 2 and 3, an embodiment of the present application provides a lithium ion battery 100, which includes a battery can 10 and a cap assembly 20.

The battery cylinder 10 includes a steel shell 11 and an inner core 12, the battery cylinder 10 is generally configured to be cylindrical, the inner core 12 is disposed inside the steel shell 11, and the inner core 12 generally includes a positive plate, a negative plate, a diaphragm, and the like, which are mature prior art, and therefore, the details are not described herein.

One end of the battery cylinder 10 is sealed, the other end of the battery cylinder is provided with an opening 13, when a battery is processed, the components of the inner core 12 are placed inside the steel shell 11 through the opening 13, the steel shell 11 positioned outside the opening 13 is turned over towards the axis direction of the battery cylinder 10 to form an accommodating cavity 14, the opening 13 is positioned on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14 is provided with a protruding part 15, and the protruding part 15 is positioned between the opening and the steel shell 11.

Because the raised part 15 is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, when the cap component 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 and seals the opening 13 of the battery cylinder 10, the raised part 15 extrudes the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24, so that the first sealing ring 24 deforms and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, the sealing property between the battery cylinder 10 and the cap component 20 is improved, the liquid inside the battery cylinder 10 is prevented from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery 100 falls from a high place, and the quality of the lithium ion battery 100 is improved.

The cap assembly 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 and seals the opening 13, and in actual production, after the cap assembly 20 seals the opening 13, the cap assembly 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 by using a sealing machine in cooperation with the lower clamping die 200 and the upper pressing film.

The cap assembly 20 comprises a steel cap 21, an explosion-proof valve 22, a metal connecting sheet 23 and a first sealing ring 24, wherein the steel cap 21, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting sheet 23 are sequentially stacked, the first sealing ring 24 sleeves the steel cap 21, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting sheet 23 inside, and sealant can be coated on the contact surfaces of the steel cap 21, the explosion-proof valve 22, the metal connecting sheet 23 and the first sealing ring 24 and fills gaps among the components to adhere the components together. When the cap assembly 20 is secured within the receiving cavity 14, the first sealing ring 24 contacts the receiving cavity 14 and seals the opening 13.

The top surface of the first sealing ring 24 is attached to the top surface of the accommodating cavity 14, the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24 is attached to the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, and the protrusion 15 extrudes the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24, so that the first sealing ring 24 deforms and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14.

According to the battery, the bulge part 15 is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, when the cap component 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 and seals the opening 13 of the battery barrel 10, the bulge part 15 can extrude the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24, so that the first sealing ring 24 can deform and be tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, the sealing performance between the battery barrel and the cap component is improved, the liquid in the battery barrel is prevented from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high position, and the quality of the lithium ion battery is improved; in the actual production process, adopt bellying 15 extrusion first sealing washer 24 bottom surface to make first sealing washer 24 take place deformation and closely laminate with holding chamber 14, also can improve the passing rate that lithium ion battery falls to detect to can improve lithium ion battery's yields, reduction in production cost.

Referring to fig. 1, 6 and 7, in the present application, the protruding portion 15 is disposed on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, and the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24 is extruded by the protruding portion 15, so that the first sealing ring 24 deforms and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, which not only improves the sealing performance between the battery barrel 10 and the cap assembly 20, but also facilitates processing, when producing a battery, the protruding portion 15 can be manufactured on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14 in the edge sealing process of the edge sealing machine only by disposing the jacking portion 210 corresponding to the protruding portion 15 on the lower clamping mold 200, the height of the jacking portion 210 can be set to 0.15 mm-0.25 mm, preferably 0.20mm, the height of the manufactured protruding portion can be 0.10mm, the operation of the whole process is simple, the processing is convenient, the use requirement can be met only by simply modifying the existing equipment, and the modification cost is low.

Referring to fig. 1, 3 and 4, in some embodiments, the protrusions 15 are annularly and continuously distributed, and the protrusions 15 surround the opening 13, when the cap assembly 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 and seals the opening 13, the annular protrusions 15 jointly press the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24 to surround the opening 13 inside, so that the first sealing ring 24 is largely deformed and tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, the sealing performance between the battery cylinder and the cap assembly is improved, and liquid inside the battery cylinder is prevented from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high place.

Referring to fig. 1, 3 and 5, in some embodiments, the protruding portion 15 includes a plurality of sub-protruding portions 15 distributed at intervals and arranged in a ring shape, and the protruding portion 15 surrounds the opening 13, when the cap assembly 20 is fixed in the receiving cavity 14 and seals the opening 13, the plurality of sub-protruding portions 15 distributed at intervals jointly press the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24, the sub-protruding portions 15 are enough to generate enough deformation for the first sealing ring 24 located between two adjacent sub-protruding portions 15 that is not directly pressed by the sub-protruding portions 15 and surround the opening 13 inside, so that the first sealing ring 24 is greatly deformed and tightly attached to the receiving cavity 14, thereby improving the sealing performance between the battery barrel and the cap assembly, preventing liquid inside the battery barrel from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high place, and the distance between two adjacent sub-protruding portions 15 is not too far, the thickness of the convex portion 15 can be set to 0.05 mm-0.15 mm, and optionally, the distance between two adjacent sub-convex portions 15 is set to 0.15 mm.

Alternatively, the sub-protrusion 15 may be configured to be cylindrical, rectangular parallelepiped, truncated cone, or hemispherical, so long as it can extrude the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24 to make the first sealing ring 24 deform to a greater extent and tightly fit with the accommodating cavity 14.

In some embodiments, in order to prevent the first seal ring 24 from being damaged by cutting caused by the side edge of the upper end surface of the protrusion 15, the side edge of the upper end surface of the protrusion 15 may be rounded, and similarly, the side edge of the upper end surface of the sub-protrusion 15 may also be rounded.

In some embodiments, in order to facilitate the processing of the protruding portion 15, it can be ensured that the first sealing ring 24 deforms to a greater extent and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, and the height of the protruding portion 15 is 0.08mm to 0.15 mm.

Optionally, the height of the protruding portion 15 is 0.10mm, so that the first sealing ring 24 can be compressed to reach an optimal deformation amount of 40% while the processing is facilitated, the first sealing ring 24 is guaranteed to deform to a large extent and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14, the sealing performance between the battery barrel and the cap assembly is improved, and liquid inside the battery barrel is prevented from leaking to the outside after the lithium ion battery falls from a high place.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, in some embodiments, the cap assembly 20 further includes a second sealing ring 25, and the second sealing ring 25 is disposed between the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting piece 23 to separate the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting piece 23.

In some embodiments, the first sealing ring 24 is made of PP or rubber, which has good sealing performance, low price and low cost, and may be made of other insulating sealing materials, such as PE, etc., and of course, the second sealing ring 25 may also be made of PP or rubber.

In some embodiments, the metal connecting sheet 23 is an aluminum sheet, which is light in material and good in conductivity, and can meet the use requirement.

In some embodiments, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting piece 23 are connected together by welding, and optionally, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting piece 23 are welded by laser, wherein the laser welding is an efficient precise welding method using a laser beam with high energy density as a heat source, and due to the high energy density of the laser welding, the deformation of the joint of the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting piece 23 can be reduced, and the precision and the strength of the joint of the two can be improved.

The utility model provides a lithium ion battery 100, which comprises a battery cylinder 10 and a cap assembly 20.

The battery cylinder 10 comprises a steel shell 11 and an inner core 12, the battery cylinder 10 is generally set to be cylindrical, the inner core 12 is arranged inside the steel shell 11, one end of the battery cylinder 10 is sealed, the other end of the battery cylinder is provided with an opening 13, when a battery is processed, the component parts of the inner core 12 are placed inside the steel shell 11 through the opening 13, the steel shell 11 positioned outside the opening 13 is turned over to the axis direction of the battery cylinder 10 to form an accommodating cavity 14, and a protruding part 15 is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14.

Boss 15 is annular continuous distribution, and boss 15 surrounds opening 13, and boss 15 highly is 0.2mm, when convenient processing, can guarantee that first sealing washer 24 takes place deformation of great degree and closely laminates with holding chamber 14.

The cap assembly 20 is fixed in the accommodating cavity 14 and seals the opening 13, the cap assembly 20 comprises a steel cap 21, an explosion-proof valve 22, a metal connecting sheet 23 and a first sealing ring 24, the steel cap 21, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting sheet 23 are sequentially stacked, the steel cap 21, the explosion-proof valve 22 and the metal connecting sheet 23 are all sleeved inside the first sealing ring 24, the first sealing ring 24 is made of PP or rubber, the metal connecting sheet 23 is an aluminum sheet, the material is light, and meanwhile, the conductivity is good.

The top surface of the first sealing ring 24 is attached to the top surface of the accommodating cavity 14, the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24 is attached to the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity 14, and the protrusion 15 extrudes the bottom surface of the first sealing ring 24, so that the first sealing ring 24 deforms and is tightly attached to the accommodating cavity 14.

This application is owing to set up bellying 15 on the bottom surface in holding chamber 14, when block subassembly 20 is fixed in holding chamber 14 and with battery barrel 10 opening 13 sealed, bellying 15 can extrude the bottom surface of first sealing washer 24, make first sealing washer 24 take place deformation and closely laminate with holding chamber 14, thereby the leakproofness between battery barrel and the block subassembly has been improved, after having avoided lithium ion battery to fall from the eminence, the inside liquid of battery barrel leaks to the outside, lithium ion battery's quality has been improved.

The above examples are only intended to illustrate the technical solution of the present invention, but not to limit it; although the present invention has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, it will be understood by those of ordinary skill in the art that: the technical solutions described in the foregoing embodiments may still be modified, or some technical features may be equivalently replaced; such modifications and substitutions do not substantially depart from the spirit and scope of the embodiments of the present invention, and are intended to be included within the scope of the present invention.
